license_required.quote: a license shall be obtained, in accordance with the provisions of this Article, before any person, firm or corporation shall engage in, or offer to engage in, the business of plumbing, heating, or fire sprinkler contracting

issuing_authority.value: State Licensing Board for General Contractors; State Board of Examiners of Plumbing, Heating, and Fire Sprinkler Contractors; State Board of Examiners of Electrical Contractors; State Board of Refrigeration Contractors
issuing_authority.quote: There is created the State Licensing Board for General Contractors

name.value: State Licensing Board for General Contractors
name.quote: There is created the State Licensing Board for General Contractors consisting of nine members appointed by the Governor

type.quote: There is created the State Licensing Board for General Contractors consisting of nine members appointed by the Governor

age_minimum.quote: Be at least 18 years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: Possess good moral character as determined by the Board.

required.quote: the experience required may not exceed two years

experience_source.quote: the experience required may not exceed two years

exams.name: General Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Tests practical knowledge, plans/specifications, NC Building Code, estimating, construction ethics, contractor laws, and Sedimentation Pollution Control Act knowledge.
exams.jurisdiction: state (State Licensing Board for General Contractors)
exams.quote: the examination shall establish (i) the ability of the applicant to make a practical application of the applicant's knowledge of the profession of contracting

exams.name: Plumbing, Heating, or Fire Sprinkler Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Two-part exam: business and law portion plus technical portion. May offer computerized exam. Applicant must wait 90 days before re-examination. Board may require additional education after three failures.
exams.jurisdiction: state (State Board of Examiners of Plumbing, Heating, and Fire Sprinkler Contractors)
exams.quote: The examination shall be conducted in two parts to include a business and law portion and a technical portion.

exams.name: Electrical Contractor Qualification Examination
exams.notes: Examination for certification as a qualified individual; includes National Electrical Code, analysis of plans, estimating, and fundamentals of installation.
exams.jurisdiction: state (State Board of Examiners of Electrical Contractors)
exams.quote: the State Board of Examiners of Electrical Contractors shall provide for the written examination of all applicants for certification as a qualified individual

exams.name: Refrigeration Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Tests technical and practical knowledge concerning analysis of plans, estimating, fundamentals of installation and design.
exams.quote: the Board shall prescribe the standard of experience to be required of an applicant for license and shall give an examination designed to ascertain the technical and practical knowledge of the applicant

exams.name: Well Contractor Certification Examination
exams.notes: Commission establishes minimum requirements of education, experience, and knowledge. Person 70+ with 20+ years experience exempt from exam.
exams.quote: The Commission, with the advice and assistance of the Secretary, shall establish minimum requirements of education, experience, and knowledge for each type of certification for well contractors

interval_years.quote: A license shall expire on the first day of January following its issuance or renewal and shall become invalid 60 days from that date unless renewed

required.quote: at least one qualifier or qualifying party of a licensee holding a building contractor, residential contractor, or unclassified contractor license classification shall complete, on an annual basis, eight hours of continuing education approved in accordance with this section

hours_per_period.quote: eight hours of continuing education approved in accordance with this section

period_years.quote: shall complete, on an annual basis, eight hours of continuing education

value: 2 hours mandatory course approved by the Board
6 hours elective courses approved by the Board
topical_requirements.quote: two hours shall be a mandatory course approved by the Board and the remaining six hours shall be elective courses approved by the Board

available.quote: To the extent that other states which provide for the licensing of general contractors provide for similar action, the Board in its discretion may grant licenses of the same or equivalent classification to general contractors licensed by other states, without written examination

requirements.value: Reciprocal license available if other state provides similar action; applicant must show qualifications equal to NC licensees and pay required fee. For electrical contractors, same mutual reciprocity standard applies. For plumbing/heating/fire sprinkler, qualifications must be substantially equivalent.
requirements.quote: upon satisfactory proof furnished to the Board that the qualifications of such applicants are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in North Carolina and upon payment of the required fee

exists.quote: There is created the State Licensing Board for General Contractors consisting of nine members appointed by the Governor

national_certification.value: National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies (NICET) - Fire Protection Engineering Technician, Level III
national_certification.quote: may accept a current certification of the National Institute for Certification in Engineering Technologies for Fire Protection Engineering Technician, Level III, subfield of Automatic Sprinkler System Layout

regulatory_model.quote: Any person, firm, or corporation not being duly authorized who shall contract for or bid upon the construction of any of the projects or works enumerated in G.S. 87-1, without having first complied with the provisions hereof, or who shall attempt to practice general contracting in the State, except as provided for in this Article...shall be deemed guilty of a Class 2 misdemeanor.

credential_type.quote: The issuance of a certificate of license or limited license by this Board shall be evidence that the person, firm, or corporation named therein is entitled to all the rights and privileges of a licensed or limited licensed general contractor

is_mandatory.quote: No person, partnership, firm or corporation shall engage, or offer to engage, in the business of electrical contracting within the State of North Carolina without having received a license

title_protection.quote: who falsely claims or suggests in connection with any business activities regulated by the Board that a person, firm, or corporation is licensed under this Chapter

scope_protection.quote: Any person, firm, or corporation not being duly authorized who shall contract for or bid upon the construction of any of the projects or works enumerated in G.S. 87-1, without having first complied with the provisions hereof, or who shall attempt to practice general contracting in the State, except as provided for in this Article...shall be deemed guilty of a Class 2 misdemeanor.

bonding_required.quote: the applicant furnishes, upon the initial application for a license, a bonding ability statement completed by a bonding company licensed to do business in North Carolina, verifying the applicant's ability to furnish performance bonds
